catalogue.detailAccess: All entries belong to this experiment. Use consult ability with its ID to retain its full executable schema for subsequent decisions. Public implementation does not grant personal mastery.

request.name: Evaluate an unknown food sample
request.function: Provide a feasible physical method to investigate an owned hazelnut sample's food suitability, nutrition or toxicity without hazardous ingestion. Report only properties supported by actual tests and explicitly retain unresolved safety uncertainty.
request.conditions: At tick 46 I own hazelnut item-32-ash-4-785. Direct visual observation established no food-safety properties. I have no observed testing equipment and retain two known-safe roots; unknown-food ingestion is unnecessary.
request.inputs: The actual owned hazelnut sample; any required tools, materials and sample quantities must be identified rather than assumed available.
request.costs: Unknown; specify realistic material, energy and time requirements before testing.
request.effects: Enable evidence-grounded sample evaluation if feasible. No automatic safety certification, nutrition knowledge, mastery or satisfaction; explain limits if local testing cannot establish safety.

shown.question: Can an actual hazelnut sample be tested for food suitability without unsafe ingestion?
evidence: Gathered one hazelnut at tick 32: item-32-ash-4-785.
Direct observation at tick 40 returned visible-state information but no nutrition or toxicity finding.
Two owned roots remain a known-safe food reserve.
shown.uncertainty: Hazelnut nutrition, toxicity, preparation requirements and feasible testing methods remain unknown.
shown.goal: Evaluate an alternative food with tolerable risk.
outputs: A visible-state observation, not a food-safety finding.
shown.missing: A feasible physical test and its actual results.
shown.next: Request a capability to evaluate the sample safely.

input.contextPolicy: Object IDs refer to deduplicated actual applicant observations. Whole records are selected with omission counts. Missing detail is unknown, not proof of absence. Full retained state is available during the development handoff; implementation must validate actual prerequisites and ownership.
input.implementation: New interfaces, state, geometry, persistent processes, rendering components and personal memory/task adapters can be delivered through a versioned current-conversation handoff. Source validation and history must remain intact. Declared implementation does not supply stock, objects or mastery.
